56860.summary: The class explores the concept of angels as messengers in both Old and New Testaments, emphasizing their roles in guiding and supporting believers towards salvation. It highlights angels' involvement in believers' lives and their ability to adapt and work with individuals despite their imperfections.

56861.summary: The class explores the role of angels in divine providence, emphasizing their function as ministers sent to guide those who will inherit salvation. It discusses how angels work within God's will and power, using examples from scripture to illustrate their influence in human lives.

56862.summary: The class explores the concept of free will in relation to divine providence and the role of angels in human lives. It emphasizes that while God knows the future, humans retain the ability to make choices, which is essential for salvation and willing obedience.

56863.summary: The class explores the role of angels in guiding individuals, ecclesias, and nations towards salvation, emphasizing the importance of aligning one's free will with God's will. It highlights the purpose of following Christ and becoming heirs of salvation, drawing on examples from the Bible and current events.

56864.summary: The class explores the role of angels as fellow servants working alongside humans to bring about God's will. It emphasizes the future when humans will be like angels, teaching and guiding others, and discusses the attributes and responsibilities of angels in the kingdom age.
